hook: I was hurt in a crime. **Who pays** for my recovery?
hook_q: What is victim compensation and how do I apply?

slides.title: Every State has a **compensation scheme.**
slides.body: Each State Government, with the Centre, must run a scheme that funds compensation for victims, or their dependants, who suffered loss or injury from a crime and need rehabilitation.

slides.title: Who **decides the amount?**
slides.body: The District or State Legal Services Authority (DLSA/SLSA) decides how much is paid, under your State's scheme. So the amount depends on your State.

slides.title: Three **ways in.**
list: After trial, the court finds the compensation it ordered isn't enough and recommends more
The case ends in acquittal or discharge, and the court recommends compensation
Offender not traced or identified, but victim identified, and no trial: you or your dependants apply to the SLSA/DLSA

timeline.text: The court's recommendation, or your application, reaches the **SLSA or DLSA**.
The Authority must finish its enquiry and **award adequate compensation**.

slides.title: Urgent help **can't wait.**
slides.body: The SLSA/DLSA can order immediate free first aid or medical benefits, or other interim relief, on a certificate from the police (officer in charge of the station or above) or the area Magistrate.

slides.title: Hospitals must treat **free of cost.**
slides.body: Every hospital, public or private, must immediately give free first aid or medical treatment to victims of rape and related offences, acid attack, and certain POCSO offences, and inform the police.

slides.title: Women victims: **NALSA's scheme.**
slides.body: NALSA's scheme for women victims of crimes like rape and acid attack lets the victim, her dependants or the local SHO apply to the SLSA or DLSA.
slides.ref: NALSA Compensation Scheme for Women Victims 2018 · Cl 2(1)(o), (p), 5, Schedule

sources: NALSA's Compensation Scheme for Women Victims/Survivors of Sexual Assault/other Crimes – 2018
caption:
Hurt in a crime? You may be able to get compensation from your State's victim compensation scheme. 👇

1️⃣ Every State, with the Centre, must run a scheme to compensate crime victims or their dependants who need rehabilitation
2️⃣ The DLSA or SLSA decides the amount, so it depends on your State's scheme
3️⃣ The court can recommend compensation, even if the case ends in acquittal or discharge
4️⃣ Offender not traced or identified, but the victim is identified, and no trial? You can apply directly to the SLSA or DLSA
5️⃣ The enquiry must be completed within 2 months, and urgent free medical help or interim relief can be ordered
6️⃣ It is in addition to fines paid to the victim under certain BNS sections (rape, gang rape, acid attack)

Source: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Sec 396, 397); NALSA Compensation Scheme for Women Victims, 2018
